newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds close down after U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds close down after U.S. jobs data.

text.p: 1545 GMT - Austrian bonds reversed their recent bull run on Thursday after weaker than expected U.S. jobless claims data encouraged profit-taking.
Claims for the week ending October 5 were at 319,000, below forecasts of around 340,000, rekindling fears of inflation.
"I think we have seen the high point for the next couple of weeks," said a trader. "Nervousness has encouraged profit taking and liquidating of long positions."
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent down 20 bps at 101.60 to yield 6.04 (6.01) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.36/46 to yield 6.07/05 percent.
* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 unchanged at 102.45 to yield 4.90 (4.90) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 102.41/51 to yield 4.91/88 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds unchanged at seven bps, five-year spread down three bps to zero.
* December AGB future down 28 bps at 105.63 on volume of 680 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
